measurementParameters._amendmentReason: Proposal Revision 2 section 7 assigns the minimum observable pause and the resume debounce to rule data, but the sketched SignalLibrary rule shape has no slot for parameters that are not comparison thresholds. A sibling measurementParameters block keeps them in rule data as section 7 requires while staying importable through SignalLibraryRegistry.importJSON. Boundary resolution: the activity gate (onset/offset dB above the estimated floor) lives in the estimator configuration, where section 4.4 names it explicitly; only the pause-DEFINITION parameters live here. Values carried over unchanged from SilenceTracker (SpeechRecognitionManager.swift:223/234).

numeric.rationale: 6 dB is approximately a doubling of amplitude; a deliberately large, round, UNCALIBRATED default - not validated against perception or any reference annotation.
Mirror of the rise rule at the same uncalibrated magnitude.

rules.name: Window median F0 above the span baseline

numeric.rationale: 4 semitones is a third - audible as a clear pitch change, chosen as a round uncalibrated default. No perceptual or clinical validation exists for this value.

rules.name: Window median F0 below the span baseline

numeric.rationale: Mirror of the rise rule at the same uncalibrated magnitude.

rules.name: Estimated syllable rate above the span baseline

numeric.rationale: 1.5 detected nuclei per active second above the speaker's own span baseline. An uncalibrated default over an estimated, reference-unscored nucleus rate - not a validated speaking-rate threshold.
